name: Band Front Raise
description: Standing on a resistance band with an end in each hand, lift both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

source.title: Set For Set: Resistance band shoulder exercises
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand on the middle of the band, feet hip-width apart.
Hold an end in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
cues: Arms long, a soft bend in the elbows.

prescription.note: Lower slowly; don't swing or lean back.

keyframes.name: Arms down
keyframes.cue: Stand on the band, hands in front of your thighs.

keyframes.name: Raise
keyframes.cue: Lift both arms straight in front to shoulder height.
